title: Choose the Visual World
question: The roll assigned the Formula 1 Pit Wall. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Formula 1 Pit Wall
options.thesis: The command center that treats employee attendance like split-second telemetry.
options.viewport: A dense, high-contrast dashboard prioritizing real-time active/inactive status and absolute clarity.
options.risk: Reads overly intense or stressful for everyday admin tasks.

raised.raise: The roster updates inherit a mechanical, flipping cadence.

options.label: Rail Concourse Split-Flap
options.thesis: The dashboard as a physical, mechanical arrivals board.
options.viewport: A split-flap table where employee statuses clack into place.
options.case: Fuses perfectly with 'checked in/out' states, holding attention through mechanical motion.
options.risk: Can become visually noisy with too many rapid updates.

options.label: Breathing Tensegrity Column
options.case: Fuses poorly: attendance tracking doesn't map cleanly to load-bearing physics.
options.kept: A network graph visualization for organizational teams.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.viewport: The standard arrangement an admin expects: a sidebar, top KPIs, and a clean white table.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from every other corporate tool.
